taxonomy_note: Analyst planning lens; reassess actual root cause.

controls.boundary: SQL injection and structural query control — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Open the driver call, bound parameter list, query builder/raw fragment and second-order consumers. Identify the database dialect and whether caller input controls a value, identifier or SQL structure.
controls.controlled_verification: Use a disposable database with one public and one hidden synthetic row. Compare a literal search containing punctuation with the suspected structural path and record the query/bindings and selected fixture rows. For a stored sort/filter value, follow it through the later reporting job instead of stopping at safe insertion. No production row extraction or delay probe is needed.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A database syntax error is a candidate. A bound value containing SQL punctuation is still data. An ORM name does not make raw fragments safe, but a trusted constant selected by a closed map can defeat the structural-control hypothesis.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Bind data values with the driver API and map structural choices to approved constants. Retest normal filters/sorting, literal punctuation, the original structural path and database privilege assumptions.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
